introduction: Explore the ruined zoo and help a hunter finish his collection of dangerous creatures' teeth.
orientation: The zoo connects to the ruined city park. Its abandoned buildings and enclosures shelter strange, altered animals.
Find the hunter and ask about hunt, prey, hunting or help. These are different ways to hear the same request.
He needs one saber tooth and one gorilla tooth together. Look for the saber-toothed tiger and the four-armed gorilla, or obtain the matching teeth from another adventurer.
Carry both teeth loose in your inventory when you offer them. The hunter rewards the pair with a thin helmet of bark, then leaves.
Look carefully around the keeper's house for a way into the lower cage. Plan your return before entering unfamiliar enclosures.

contacts.name: a malformed vulture
contacts.description: Too many years of nesting within these ruins have turned this vulture into a misshapen freak of nature.

contacts.name: a three-tailed zebra
contacts.description: This zebra is deformed in many ways, but the most noticeable deformity is the three tails that drag along the ground behind it.

contacts.name: a saber-toothed tiger
contacts.description: A saber-toothed tiger lurks in a filthy cage. Its long tooth is one of the two the hunter needs.

contacts.name: a hunter
contacts.description: A hunter searches the ruins for tracks. He needs two more teeth to finish his necklace.

contacts.name: a four-armed gorilla
contacts.description: The four-armed gorilla has shiny red teeth. Search beneath the keeper's house for its cage.

contacts.name: a five-humped camel
contacts.description: Five misshaped, disproportinate, swollen humps rise up from this camel's back.

contacts.name: a hairless, translucent mammoth
contacts.description: Something has gone terribly wrong and this mammoth is bald and its skin has become completely translucent.

contacts.name: a drider
contacts.description: There is no telling how long this drider has lived within these ruins.

contacts.name: a fiery-eyed nightmare
contacts.description: This nightmare is rampaging around the room in a rage.

contacts.name: a blue monkey
contacts.description: This creature has less noticeable mutations than most of the other animals around here, but something about it still just doesn't quite seem right.

contacts.name: a large blue monkey
contacts.description: This monkey looks much like the smaller monkeys in this area, except that it is much larger.

contacts.name: a sewer rat
contacts.description: This disgusting creature needs to be driven back into the sewers.

contacts.name: a zoo keeper
contacts.description: The keeper still walks through the ruined zoo, cleaning up after its animals.

stories.title: Complete the hunter’s tooth collection
stories.summary: The hunter is two teeth short of completing his necklace. Offer a saber tooth and a gorilla tooth together to receive a thin helmet of bark.

steps.hint: Obtain the saber-toothed tiger's tooth and carry it loose in your inventory. A matching tooth supplied by another adventurer works too.
Obtain the four-armed gorilla's tooth and carry it loose in your inventory. Look for the lower cage beneath the keeper's house.
Offer both different teeth together to the hunter. He rewards the pair and departs.
